Coastal 5-Bedroom Home in Nyali

TX-1018 · Nyali, Mombasa · listed 19 January 2026

A TRIXX-built swahili coastal home in Nyali, Mombasa. Built to the basic smart specification with the full device schedule fitted and commissioned before handover. The plot is 0.5 acre with 385 square metres under roof across 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms.
